jobs.title: Finance & BizOps, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
TL;DR: Be the strategic finance partner to Lovable's Partnerships organization. You will own the financial architecture behind every strategic alliance: hyperscalers, LLM providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. You’ll structure deals, price partnerships, build the operational workflows, and drive accountability through performance measurement. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where your analysis directly shapes which partnerships Lovable enters, how they're structured, and whether they deliver. 



Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.



What We’re Looking For

Partnership deal architect: You have deep experience structuring complex technology partnerships such as usage-based pricing, compute commit deals, revenue shares, referral and reseller programs, co-sell motions, and first-party product integrations. You can take an ambiguous partner opportunity and translate it into a decision-ready business case with clear assumptions, scenario analyses, and quantified tradeoffs. You've sat across the table from hyperscaler and platform partnership teams and understand how these deals actually get done.

Deal economics modeler: You build models that leadership uses to make consequential decisions: partnership P&Ls, deal pricing frameworks, margin and compute cost analyses, and payback curves. You can evaluate a partnership not just on headline revenue but on incrementality, margin impact, and long-term strategic value. You communicate tradeoffs with clarity and confidence, including when the numbers don't support the deal.

Deal operator & governance designer: You build the systems that make partnerships work at scale — contract-to-cash workflows, partner billing and revenue share calculations, deal approval policies, attribution frameworks, and post-signature governance. You see this operational infrastructure as the difference between partnerships that compound value and partnerships that slowly die. You design processes that are rigorous enough to maintain financial discipline and light enough to not slow down a fast-moving deals team.

Technical and analytical: Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure.

High-slope learner: You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10.

Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience in strategic finance, partnerships finance, or deal operations at a high-growth AI or technology company. Direct experience structuring or evaluating partnerships with hyperscalers, LLM providers, or major platform companies is highly valued. Bachelor's degree required.


What You’ll Do

Own partnership economics end-to-end. Build and own the models and business cases for partnerships, including pricing structures, unit economics, margin and compute cost implications, and scenario analyses. Evaluate partnerships on incrementality and long-term value creation, not just headline revenue.

Build and run partnership operations at scale. Design and operationalize the processes that turn signed deals into shipped value: partner onboarding, billing flows, revenue share calculations, attribution tracking, invoicing, and ongoing reporting. Own the contract-to-cash workflow and ensure it's accurate, auditable, and scalable as the partnership portfolio grows.

Lead deal structuring and negotiation support. Partner with deal leads to price and structure partnerships from early-stage evaluation through final term-sheet negotiation. Prepare executive-ready recommendations with clear tradeoffs, guardrails, and redlines. Identify recurring contract risks and build internal frameworks that enable the team to move fast without compromising financial discipline.

Accelerate with AI: Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer. You're expected to continuously push what's possible, replacing manual processes with scalable infrastructure that moves at Lovable's speed.





About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

As Solutions Marketing Lead, you'll own the strategy for how we show up and win across a wide range of markets, audiences, and use cases, many of which we're still in the process of defining. The first priority market segment to focus on will be SMB. Over time you'll move between buyer segments fluidly, building the playbooks and messaging that turn early traction into repeatable motion from the ground up.



You will spend your time across the full arc of go-to-market work: spotting the opportunity, developing the hypothesis, designing the experiment, and synthesizing what you learn into a recommendation leadership acts on.  - 12+ years of marketing experience with a deep understanding of the SMB audience

 - Owned a solutions marketing playbook from zero to one at a B2B SaaS or developer-focused company, not just executed against one someone else built.

 - Directly owned a large, cross-functional initiative where you were the person accountable for the outcome, not just coordinating the calendar.

 - Designed a GTM experiment, read the signal, and turned it into a recommendation that leadership acted on.

 - Marketed across multiple audiences at once while keeping a coherent brand narrative, not five disconnected campaigns that don't feel like the same company.

 - Positioned developer tools, no-code/low-code platforms, or AI products, and understand the nuances of speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Own the GTM strategy for new and evolving market opportunities: identify where we have potential to win, build the hypotheses, and design the experiments to validate them.

 - Go from 0 to 1 across multiple use cases, personas, and buyer segments simultaneously, developing positioning, messaging, and campaign infrastructure from scratch.

 - Lead major cross-functional initiatives spanning marketing, product, GTM, content, and community, driving alignment and shipping with urgency.

 - Develop Lovable's solutions positioning across individual creators, freelancers, startups, agencies, and growing teams across multiple verticals.

 - Build segment-specific GTM playbooks, including messaging frameworks, campaign strategies, PLG motions, and sales enablement, that scale across the organization.

 


ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

jobs.title: Growth Lead, Brazil
jobs.description:
TL;DR: Brazil is one of Lovable's largest and fastest-growing markets, and it got there almost entirely on its own energy. The community runs its own Lovable Days. A Lovable Summit exists because Brazilian builders willed it into existence. The title says Growth Lead, but make no mistake: this is our general manager for Brazil. You'll own the market like a founder and carry the commercial judgment of someone who has opened Brazil for technology companies before. You know which doors to open, which to keep closed, and when the timing is right for each bet. You'll sit inside Product & Engineering because Brazil grows through Product-led Growth, and the product is one of your commercial levers: if checkout doesn't speak Pix or parcelamento, if BRL pricing is wrong, you drive the fix.




WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams worldwide. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Brazil is one of our largest and fastest-growing markets, with millions of founders, students, freelancers, and small businesses building on their own, plus an enterprise and public sector hungry to build. Whoever takes this role will not inherit a playbook. They will write the one everyone else copies.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - The Brazil P&L mindset, end to end: Acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. One market, full funnel, your number, your bets.

 - The commercial strategy: Decide where Lovable plays first: SMB, enterprise, education, public sector, partnerships. Sequence the bets, say no to the wrong ones, and open the doors that matter through your own network.

 - The Brazilian ecosystem: From boardrooms and executive networks to Campus Party, Web Summit Rio, South Summit, Gramado Summit, community-run Lovable events, and the WhatsApp groups where Brazil actually lives.

 - Product changes that unlock the market: Talk to users and buyers constantly, then drive what ships with product and engineering: Pix and parcelamento, BRL pricing and packaging, PT-BR onboarding, templates, and the integrations Brazilian companies expect.




WHAT YOU ARE

You've done this before. You've opened or scaled the Brazilian market for technology companies, and you carry the scar tissue and the network to prove it.

 - Commercially mature: A decade or more of building technology businesses in Brazil, ideally including executive roles (CIO, CTO, country or commercial leadership) and board exposure. You know the right people, and more importantly, you know which conversations to have and which to skip.

 - A strategic operator: You think in bets and sequencing. You can articulate what Lovable should optimize for in Brazil, and what it should deliberately ignore for now.

 - Technically savvy: You're credible with engineers, understand PLG mechanics, and use Lovable yourself. You don't need to write the code, but you understand exactly what the product needs to win here.

 - Native or near-native in Portuguese and fluent in English, our company language.

 - A builder at heart: Titles aside, you prefer doing over coordinating. There is no Brazil playbook at Lovable yet. That's the point.




WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not "run Brazilian social media." 

 - Not "translate our global marketing calendar." 

 - Not "send HQ a deck about Brazil." 

You have the freedom, and the responsibility, to set the commercial strategy, shape the product, and define how Lovable shows up in Brazil. 
The goal is simple: make Brazil one of Lovable's strongest markets in the world.




ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - Don't send us a cover letter. Build something on Lovable and send us the link in the application form, plus a short note (Portuguese or English, your call) on the bets you believe Lovable should and should not make in Brazil over the next 18 months.

 - Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

 - We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Role summary

Lovable is a deeply technical product. Making Lovable the best it can possibly be for our users means deep relationships with the companies building technology that powers and integrates with it — model providers, cloud and infrastructure platforms, developer tools, and the services our users expect to integrate with.

We're hiring a Product Partnership Manager in Stockholm to own that surface. You will source, negotiate, manage, and grow partnerships with the world's leading technology companies to power and integrate with Lovable's product and our business. These are our most technical partnerships: the terms are complex, the integrations are real engineering work, and the decisions you make shape what millions of people can build.

This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of critical partnerships who will be deeply embedded with the product and engineering teams.

What we’re looking for

 - 7+ years in product partnerships, platform partnerships, or business development, at a software, technology or developer-tools company or adjacent roles/companies

 - Commercial depth. You've structured and closed complex technical and commercial agreements, and you know how to work cross-functionally (e.g. PM, Eng, legal and finance) to close them. You have a clear sense of how value flows in both directions.

 - Technically credible. While not technical, you can understand and articulate the technology and can hold your own with engineering teams on both sides of the table.

 - Relationship range. Comfortable managing working level partner manager to a C-level exec in the same week, and a natural internal collaborator — particularly with PM, where you'll work closely and regularly.

 - Data-driven and high agency. You define the metrics, track them, and let them drive prioritization and define partnership success. You have a clear point of view on which partnerships earn Lovable’s trust and which don't.

 - Nice to have: a technical or product background — time spent as an engineer, PM, or founder, so you've been on the building side of an integration and not just the deal side. Experience with AI-native products, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems (APIs, webhooks, marketplace listings) is also useful.

What you’ll do

 - Own a named portfolio of Lovable's technical partnerships end to end — from sourcing and first conversation through onboarding, ramp, renewal and where applicable GTM motions.

 - Negotiate the partnership’s scope and commercial terms, working closely with legal, finance, and product.

 - Deliver excellent partner management by run the operating rhythm across your partners: driving business reviews, executive touch points and managing escalations.

 - Where applicable, define joint GTM motions with partners — e.g. co-marketing, integration announcements — hand in hand with Lovable's GTM / marketing team.

 - Be the internal voice of your partners: surface feedback, blockers, and opportunities that shape Lovable's roadmap, and carry Lovable's priorities into their roadmaps.

 - Be a strong voice in the room with product and engineering to influence Lovable's roadmap in the best interests of our users and our partner ecosystem.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
